# The command prompt (C4.10): i-mux's rename-tab binding (prefix and a key; command-prompt -I
# with the tab's name, -p, and a template with %%%), line editing, Escape, several prompts and
# %% and %1 substitution.
conf messages.conf
size 60x10
run new-session -d -s a -n w 'exec cat'
client c 60x10
run bind T command-prompt -I '#{@imux_tab}' -p 'Tab name:' 'set-option -w @imux_tab "%%%"' ; set -w -t a @imux_tab 'old name'
type c '\x02T'
screen c
# C-u clears the input; a name with spaces, quotes, $ and ; is set as typed.
type c '\x15my "quoted" $tab; x'
screen c
type c '\r'
screen c
run display-message -p -t a '#{@imux_tab}'
# Line editing: Left, Home, End, Backspace, Delete, C-a, C-e, C-w.
type c '\x02T'
screen c
type c '\x1b[D\x1b[DZ'
screen c
type c '\x1b[H\x1b[3~A\x1b[F!\x7f?'
screen c
type c '\x01<\x05>'
screen c
type c '\x17\x17'
screen c
type c '\r'
screen c
run display-message -p -t a '#{@imux_tab}'
# Escape cancels.
type c '\x02T'
screen c
type c 'nope'
screen c
type c '\x1b'
screen c
run display-message -p -t a '#{@imux_tab}'
# Two prompts, %1 and %2; %% single-quoted.
run bind U command-prompt -I 'x,y' -p 'one,two' 'set -g @p "%1|%2"' ; bind V command-prompt -p 'q' "set -g @q %%"
type c '\x02U'
screen c
type c '1\r'
screen c
type c '2\r'
screen c
run display-message -p '#{@p}'
type c '\x02V'
screen c
type c "it's\r"
screen c
run display-message -p '#{@q}'
# Without a status line the prompt takes the last line.
run set -g status off
type c '\x02T'
screen c
type c '\x1b'
run kill-server
